comment: SansAmp Bass Driver DI (V1 late) white-box-style replica for the Zoom B1on/G1on. Original DSP modeled stage-by-stage from community-traced schematics (see docs/CIRCUIT_V1_LATE.md); NOT affiliated with Tech 21. 8 knobs: P1 Presence/Drive/Blend, P2 Bass/Treble/Mid, P3 Level/Mode (0=V1 late, mid=V1 early, max=V2).
gid_comment: 0x04 = AMP category (G1on AMP wrapping, CABI block).
fxid_comment: 0x01A8 in the custom effect range (after AmpNeve 420/422, Reverson 411).

params.name: Presence
params.comment: P1 K1: HF character shelf (~3 kHz), -4..+10 dB.

params.name: Drive
params.comment: P1 K2: module gain into the 3.3V zener pair.

params.name: Blend
params.comment: P1 K3: dry/processed mix (100% = full SansAmp).

params.name: Bass
params.comment: P2 K1: peaking ~80 Hz (60 Hz in V2), flat at center.

params.name: Treble
params.comment: P2 K2: peaking ~3 kHz, flat at center.

params.name: Mid
params.comment: P2 K3: V2-mode mid (500 Hz); inactive in V1 modes.
